raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Qwen4Exp QSA repeats prefill scoring and Top-K on every TP rank. Assign complete prefill query rows to ranks and gather the final `int32` indices, reusing the existing scorer and Top-K with replicated K/cache.

This applies the row-ownership principle from #54394 to QSA's separate model/indexer path. It does not depend on that PR.

## Claims

- Lower long-context prefill latency on 4×H20: about **7.4% lower TTFT at 256K/C1 with MTP disabled**, reproduced across two independent boot pairs. MTP-enabled measurements also improved TTFT by 3–8% at 128K/256K, C1/C4.
- Automatically enable only for single-node MP, SM90, TP4, BF16 indexer H4/D128, selection budget 2048, compression 4, at least 4096 actual prefill rows and 64K context. Other configurations retain replicated selection; a scheduling token budget of 799 does not activate it.
- Decode uses its existing path. This is a prefill latency claim, not a claim of decode acceleration or regression-free generation.

## Validation

**Independent serving ABBA**, baseline `e11a5ada533`, identical image/flags in both arms, Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-FP8, TP4+EP, Triton MoE, token budget 8192, Mamba `align`, MTP off, prefix cache cleared per request. Two 262144-token authored document-retrieval tasks; temperature 0, seed 1731, natural EOS, up to 1024 output tokens. Four fresh starts, 32 requests including 24 formal samples, all formal structured answers correct. No APC hits, preemptions or thermal throttling.

Cells show the two boot-pair medians; changes are the geometric mean of the paired ratios.

| Task | Baseline TTFT (s) | Patched TTFT (s) | TTFT change | Full-request change |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| KV-cache document | 14.716 / 14.693 | 13.607 / 13.607 | -7.46% | -6.68% |
| Parallel-config document | 14.692 / 14.681 | 13.588 / 13.605 | -7.42% | -7.71% |

Target TPOT changed +0.74% / -1.09% across the two pairs. Natural output lengths vary, so full-request changes are observations, not fixed-workload throughput gains.

**Correctness:** 97 targeted GPU tests passed (96 reference/configuration tests + one real TP4 test), covering fallback boundaries, ragged rows, offset views, one-row chunks, and exact-score ties. Twenty-four real-input rank checks matched selected-score multisets exactly; tied scores can yield different valid index sets. Synthetic 128K/256K retrieval was 32/32 correct per arm. These are narrow regressions, not broad model accuracy evaluation.

Reproduce the suites and the included selector benchmark in a CUDA vLLM environment:

```bash
uv run --offline --no-project .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/models/qwen4_exp/test_qsa_reference.py -q
uv run --offline --no-project .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/models/qwen4_exp/test_tpsp.py -k qsa_tp_prefill -q
uv run --offline --no-project .venv/bin/python -m torch.distributed.run --standalone --nproc-per-node=4 benchmarks/kernels/benchmark_qsa_tp_prefill.py --output qsa-tp4.json
```

The recorded GPU runs used copies of these suites with an isolated pytest configuration against the installed candidate. All applicable pre-commit hooks passed. Existing single-GPU Qwen CI covers the reference suite; this PR adds an optional four-H100 nightly entry for the TP4 test. Full repository CI has not been run locally.

<details>
<summary>Additional serving results and reproduction settings</summary>

With MTP=3, a separate clean-process ABBA completed 104 requests (64 formal), with the same TP4/8192 configuration:

| Input | Concurrency | TTFT change | Full-request change |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 128K | 1 | -3.02% | -3.37% |
| 128K | 4 | -3.80% | -3.75% |
| 256K | 1 | -7.69% | -7.61% |
| 256K | 4 | -8.10% | -9.33% |

Valid structured answers were 28/28 per arm. One of eight authored questions had an outdated premise and was uniformly excluded from quality before candidate results; its performance/output was retained.

Generation-side adverse observations are retained: an earlier MTP-on target had +14.85%/+19.70% TPOT; a prespecified follow-up (48/48 formal answers correct) gave -4.94%/-2.74% on that target and +8.86%/+1.44% on its control. Forced-generation probes had +63.70%/+12.04% TPOT. These runs do not establish a causal explanation or generation equivalence; the supported claim remains prefill latency.

Serving used `--gpu-memory-utilization 0.90 --max-model-len 1048576 --max-num-seqs 64 --enable-chunked-prefill --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 --mamba-cache-mode align --enable-prefix-caching --no-enable-flashinfer-autotune`, plus TP4/EP and `--moe-backend triton`. YaRN overrides: `rope_type=yarn`, `rope_theta=10000000`, `factor=4`, `original_max_position_embeddings=262144`, `partial_rotary_factor=0.25`, `mrope_interleaved=true`, `mrope_section=[11,11,10]`. MTP was omitted for the primary comparison and configured with three draft tokens for the additional comparison. Requests used `/v1/completions`, pretokenized prompts, streaming token IDs, and `logprobs=1`; `/reset_prefix_cache` ran before each batch. Actual tested contexts were at most 256K, concurrency at most four. LMCache was disabled.

The included kernel benchmark measures warm-cache selection **including production all-gather**, taking each sample's slowest rank. It is not the source of the serving speedup claim.

</details>

## Details

Each rank scores complete rows against the full key history; only final indices are exchanged. Equal-sized gather buffers are trimmed to the original row count. DCP/PCP, batch-invariant execution, disabled PyNCCL, NCCL symmetric-memory collectives and FULL mixed graphs fall back. See the [user documentation](https://github.com/positive666/vllm/blob/d7eb414a6694a488771e0cc57a9fd69d2a481ce7/docs/configuration/optimization.md#qwen38-flash-next-qsa-prefill).

Non-duplication checked on 2026-11-04: #54394 covers DSA, #61242 shards QSA keys/cache for DCP, #65470 compacts a kernel's mixed-request grid, and #59010 changes sparse-attention computation. This patch partitions QSA prefill query rows under ordinary TP with DCP=1. Combined performance with those changes is untested. H100/H200 performance, TP8, production P99 and broad model accuracy are unmeasured.

AI assistance was used for implementation, experiments and analysis. The submitting human confirmed reviewing every changed line and personally running the relevant tests, and separately reviewed the added CI entry.

---

- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.
- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.

- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.

</details>

+  - tests/models/qwen4_exp/test_tpsp.py

@@ -0,0 +1,152 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Compare replicated QSA selection with TP row ownership, including exchange.
+
+Run with torchrun --standalone --nproc-per-node=4. CUDA events measure the
+slowest rank per sample; allocations and Python dispatch are included between
+events. Inputs are reused in device caches. This is not a serving benchmark.
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import os
+import statistics
+from functools import partial
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+
+import vllm.envs as envs
+from vllm.config import ParallelConfig, VllmConfig, set_current_vllm_config
+from vllm.distributed import (
+    cleanup_dist_env_and_memory,
+    get_tp_group,
+    init_distributed_environment,
+    initialize_model_parallel,
+)
+from vllm.models.qwen4_exp.nvidia.ops.qsa_indexer import qsa_select_paged_prefill
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--rows", type=int, nargs="+", default=[799, 4096, 8192])
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--contexts", type=int, nargs="+", default=[32768, 65536, 131072]
+    )
+    parser.add_argument("--samples", type=int, default=21)
+    parser.add_argument("--warmup", type=int, default=8)
+    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    rank, world = int(os.environ["RANK"]), int(os.environ["WORLD_SIZE"])
+    torch.accelerator.set_device_index(int(os.environ["LOCAL_RANK"]))
+    torch.set_num_threads(1)
+    init_distributed_environment(
+        world_size=world, rank=rank, distributed_init_method="env://"
+    )
+    config = VllmConfig(parallel_config=ParallelConfig(tensor_parallel_size=world))
+    try:
+        with set_current_vllm_config(config):
+            initialize_model_parallel(tensor_model_parallel_size=world)
+            group = get_tp_group()
+            results = []
+            for context in args.contexts:
+                for rows in args.rows:
+                    if rows > context:
+                        continue
+                    torch.manual_seed(0)
+                    pages = (context // 4 + 207) // 208
+                    q = torch.randn(rows, 4, 128, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")
+                    cache = torch.randn(
+                        pages, 208, 1, 128, dtype=q.dtype, device=q.device
+                    )
+                    table = torch.arange(pages, dtype=torch.int32, device=q.device)[
+                        None
+                    ]
+                    starts = torch.tensor([0, rows], dtype=torch.int32, device=q.device)
+                    visible = (
+                        torch.arange(
+                            context - rows + 1,
+                            context + 1,
+                            dtype=torch.int32,
+                            device=q.device,
+                        )
+                        // 4
+                    )
+                    out = torch.empty(rows, 512, dtype=torch.int32, device=q.device)
+                    for epoch, shard in enumerate((False, True, True, False)):
+                        call = partial(
+                            qsa_select_paged_prefill,
+                            q,
+                            cache,
+                            table,
+                            starts,
+                            visible,
+                            2048,
+                            4,
+                            rows,
+                            out,
+                            context,
+                            tp_group=group if shard else None,
+                        )
+
+                        for _ in range(args.warmup):
+                            call()
+                        torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+                        begin = torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True)
+                        end = torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True)
+                        samples = []
+                        for _ in range(args.samples):
+                            dist.barrier(group=group.cpu_group)
+                            begin.record()
+                            call()
+                            end.record()
+                            end.synchronize()
+                            samples.append(begin.elapsed_time(end) * 1000)
+                        all_samples = [None] * world
+                        dist.all_gather_object(
+                            all_samples, samples, group=group.cpu_group
+                        )
+                        critical = [max(values) for values in zip(*all_samples)]
+                        result = dict(
+                            rows=rows,
+                            context=context,
+                            epoch=epoch,
+                            sharded=shard,
+                            critical_us=critical,
+                            median_us=statistics.median(critical),
+                        )
+                        results.append(result)
+                        if rank == 0:
+                            print(
+                                json.dumps(
+                                    {
+                                        k: v
+                                        for k, v in result.items()
+                                        if k != "critical_us"
+                                    }
+                                ),
+                                flush=True,
+                            )
+            if rank == 0:
+                args.output.write_text(
+                    json.dumps(
+                        {
+                            "tp": world,
+                            "gpu": torch.cuda.get_device_name(),
+                            "logits_mb": envs.VLLM_SPARSE_INDEXER_MAX_LOGITS_MB,
+                            "scope": (
+                                "warm-cache selector plus production all-gather; "
+                                "maximum-rank CUDA event time"
+                            ),
+                            "results": results,
+                        },
+                        indent=2,
+                    )
+                )
+    finally:
+        cleanup_dist_env_and_memory()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

 See related papers for more details (<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2401.08671> or <https://arxiv.org/pdf/2308.16369>).
 
+## Qwen3.8-Flash-Next QSA prefill
+
+On a single NVIDIA SM90 node with tensor parallel size 4 and the multiprocessing executor, the Qwen4Exp QSA indexer automatically distributes large prefill query batches across ranks and gathers the selected indices. The measured path uses BF16 indexer Q/K, four 128-dimensional indexer heads, a 2048-token selection budget, and compression ratio 4. It requires at least 4096 actual prefill rows in the scheduling step and a maximum context length of at least 65536 tokens; `--max-num-batched-tokens` alone does not determine eligibility. Smaller batches retain replicated selection, including a token budget of 799.
+
+Decode remains unchanged. DCP, PCP, batch-invariant execution, disabled PyNCCL, NCCL symmetric-memory collectives, and FULL graphs for mixed batches retain replicated selection. The optimization adds no CLI option; changing the prefill token budget affects scheduling independently of this optimization.
+
 ## Parallelism Strategies
 
 vLLM supports multiple parallelism strategies that can be combined to optimize performance across different hardware configurations.

@@ -1410,3 +1410,87 @@ def position_row(request: int, position: int) -> torch.Tensor:
                 rope_cache[block, position % 4, 0],
                 position_row(request, position).to("cuda"),
             )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "rows,seq_len,dtype,heads,topk,ratio,enabled,expected",
+    [
+        (4096, 65536, torch.bfloat16, 4, 2048, 4, True, True),
+        (8192, 131072, torch.bfloat16, 4, 2048, 4, True, True),
+        (799, 131072, torch.bfloat16, 4, 2048, 4, True, False),
+        (4095, 65536, torch.bfloat16, 4, 2048, 4, True, False),
+        (4096, 65535, torch.bfloat16, 4, 2048, 4, True, False),
+        (8192, 131072, torch.float8_e4m3fn, 4, 2048, 4, True, False),
+        (8192, 131072, torch.bfloat16, 8, 2048, 4, True, False),
+        (8192, 131072, torch.bfloat16, 4, 1024, 4, True, False),
+        (8192, 131072, torch.bfloat16, 4, 2048, 2, True, False),
+        (8192, 131072, torch.bfloat16, 4, 2048, 4, False, False),
+    ],
+)
+def test_qsa_tp_prefill_keeps_unmeasured_workloads_replicated(
+    rows, seq_len, dtype, heads, topk, ratio, enabled, expected
+) -> None:
+    q = torch.empty((rows, heads, 128), dtype=dtype, device="meta")
+    assert (
+        qsa_indexer._use_tp_prefill_sharding(enabled, q, seq_len, topk, ratio)
+        is expected
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "tp,dcp,pcp,graph,disabled_env",
+    [
+        (4, 1, 1, "PIECEWISE", None),
+        (1, 1, 1, "PIECEWISE", None),
+        (2, 1, 1, "PIECEWISE", None),
+        (8, 1, 1, "PIECEWISE", None),
+        (4, 2, 1, "PIECEWISE", None),
+        (4, 1, 2, "PIECEWISE", None),
+        (4, 1, 1, "FULL", None),
+        (4, 1, 1, "PIECEWISE", "VLLM_DISABLE_PYNCCL"),
+        (4, 1, 1, "PIECEWISE", "VLLM_USE_NCCL_SYMM_MEM"),
+        (4, 1, 1, "PIECEWISE", "VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_qsa_tp_prefill_configuration_fallbacks(
+    monkeypatch, tp, dcp, pcp, graph, disabled_env
+) -> None:
+    from vllm.config import CompilationConfig, ParallelConfig, VllmConfig
+    from vllm.config.compilation import CUDAGraphMode
+
+    for name in (
+        "VLLM_DISABLE_PYNCCL",
+        "VLLM_USE_NCCL_SYMM_MEM",
+        "VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT",
+    ):
+        monkeypatch.setenv(name, "1" if name == disabled_env else "0")
+    config = VllmConfig(
+        parallel_config=ParallelConfig(
+            tensor_parallel_size=tp,
+            decode_context_parallel_size=dcp,
+            prefill_context_parallel_size=pcp,
+            distributed_executor_backend="mp",
+        ),
+        compilation_config=CompilationConfig(cudagraph_mode=CUDAGraphMode[graph]),
+    )
+    expected = (
+        current_platform.is_cuda()
+        and current_platform.is_device_capability(90)
+        and (tp, dcp, pcp, graph, disabled_env) == (4, 1, 1, "PIECEWISE", None)
+    )
+    assert qsa_indexer._tp_prefill_sharding_supported(config) is expected
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("nodes,backend", [(2, "mp"), (1, "external_launcher")])
+def test_qsa_tp_prefill_retains_unmeasured_topologies(monkeypatch, nodes, backend):
